description: Prizes a coin can be launched with now, from Souvenir's catalogue: { prizes, total, next }. Each prize: id (what prepare_launch takes as skin), title, kind, priceUsd, from (true: a family priced from its smallest, which id names), image, and store, sizes or note when it has them. For the next page, pass next back as offset; it is null on the last page. No sign-in needed. CS2 skins are not listed here: a launch names one by its market name, such as "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)". Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize; (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

kind.description: Only one kind: goods (store items), services, gift (gift cards), stars (Telegram Stars), packs, graded (graded cards), nft (Solana NFTs), evm (Ethereum NFTs), stock (shares and tokens), cs2case (CS2 cases) or trips.
